title: ControllingBoardRequest
description: One request acted on by the Controlling Board — the execution-phase record.

stated_justification.description: The reason the agency gave, quoted or closely summarized. Not an inferred motive.

Provenance.description:
Where an extracted value came from, carried on every extraction record.

Without this a value cannot be promoted from `[inference]` to `[verified]`, since verification is defined as resting on a committed, citable source.

catalog_slug.description: Slug of the catalog entry describing the source, e.g. `lsc-hb96-comparison`.

document_ref.description: Stable locator for the document itself.

locator.description: Where inside the document — page, table, or row identifier.

retrieved.description: ISO-8601 date the source was retrieved.
